summary: Frontend-only regression test of the compact redesign on 12 report pages (admin/admin123, 1920x800, web preview). 11 of 12 pages work: compact chips, single-row filters and HTML DenseTable all render and behave correctly. One CRITICAL interaction bug: on /report-teacher-attendance the teacher suggestion dropdown cannot be clicked with a real mouse. Also /report-student (admin view) still shows big cards and is not compact, and 3 pages have the run button wrapping onto its own line. No runtime/page errors on any report page.

minor.issue: Returns students=[] at every threshold (15/25/35/50), but /api/reports/warnings returns 4 deprivations at 100% unexcused absence. The data does not match between the two reports. The absent-students table UI was checked with a mocked API response instead.

All 35 courses show present=0 and rate=0%. But /report-daily for 2026-04-14 shows lecture TEST180156 13:58 with 7 present and 7 absent, and report-course lists the same 14-Apr lectures as 'لم تنعقد (غياب المدرس)'. The reports disagree about the same lectures. Daily KPI shows 50% while the row bar shows 33% for 7/7. This is probably existing backend logic, not caused by the UI refactor.

ui_bugs.issue: The dropdown looks like it sits on top, but a real mouse click on a suggestion is captured by the element below it: [data-testid=report-kpis] after a run, and the empty-state card before a run. So the teacher cannot be selected (no selected-teacher-chip). Root cause: RN-web gives every View position:relative and z-index:0. The zIndex:50 on the teacher field is therefore trapped inside the ReportFilters card (z-index 0), and sibling elements later in the DOM paint and hit-test above it. Verified fix: setting z-index:20 on [data-testid=report-filters] in the page made the mouse click select the teacher and show the chip. Suggested change: add zIndex: 20 (plus position: 'relative') to styles.filters in ReportShell.tsx.

integration_issues.issue: report-student.tsx never reads useLocalSearchParams, so the student is not preloaded and the user lands on an empty picker. This was already the case before this change.

issues: The filter card is full screen width (x=13..1541) while the hero is limited to maxWidth 1400 (x=226..1342), so the two are misaligned.
Filters are stacked vertically: 3 full-width selects plus a search box and a full-width purple run button. Not compact, and not using ReportFilters.

Admin/staff see StudentDetailedReport with BIG KPI cards (المقررات/المحاضرات/حاضر/غائب/متأخر). The new compact student-summary chips and student-courses-table only appear in the classic fallback (student role, or when the detailed report fails), so the compact design is effectively not applied for admins.

The run-report-btn wraps onto its own row under the filters instead of sitting inline. The fields (flex:1 pickers / full-width teacher selector) take the whole row. Absent-students also puts the threshold buttons on a second row. The filter card is about 135-200px tall instead of a single compact row (compare overview, warnings, daily and teacher-attendance, which are inline).
The 'الأسبوع' column header wraps into 'الأسبو / ع'.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the overlay on the teacher-attendance suggestion dropdown: add zIndex: 20 (and position: 'relative') to styles.filters (ReportFilters card) in ReportShell.tsx. Verified in the browser.

Make /report-student compact for admins: put the filters in ReportFilters inside the reportPage.content maxWidth container, and use ReportKpis/DenseTable in StudentDetailedReport (or the summary) instead of big cards

Keep run-report-btn inline on report-course, report-absent-students and report-teacher-summary (give fields a fixed/min width instead of flex:1 spanning the row, or put the threshold buttons in the same row)
Optional: make report-student read ?id= so absent-students 'view-full' preloads the student
Optional (backend): check why absent-students returns empty while warnings/deprivations has 100%-absent students, and why overview/course show 0 attendance while daily shows 7 present
critical_code_review_comments: DenseTable uses raw <div>/<table> inside RN View. Fine on web, but it will crash on native iOS/Android if these report pages are ever rendered natively. Add a Platform.OS guard or a native fallback.
report-student.tsx (891 lines) and report-lesson-completion.tsx (687 lines) are very large; consider splitting them.

report-attendance-overview and report-daily define a local rateColor that shadows the exported ReportShell.rateColor with different thresholds (80/60 vs 90/75), so colours are inconsistent between reports.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (11/12 pages fully functional; 1 critical click-blocking bug, plus design gaps on report-student and 3 pages with a wrapped run button)

Teacher 'أستاذ اختبار 180156' has data in 2026-04. daily date 2026-04-14 has 3 lectures. Use page.mouse.click at bounding-box coordinates to detect overlay interception (Playwright's locator.click reports which element intercepts). RN-web Picker = <select>, so select_option works.
rca of the issue: teacher-attendance dropdown: react-native-web applies z-index:0 + position:relative to every View, creating a stacking context per View. The suggestionsBox (absolute, zIndex 100) inside the field (zIndex 50) is confined to the ReportFilters card's stacking context (z-index 0). Siblings rendered after the card (ReportKpis / ReportEmpty / tabs) have the same z-index and come later in the DOM, so they sit above the dropdown for hit-testing. They are transparent, which is why the dropdown still looks fine. Fix: raise the ReportFilters card's zIndex.
